summary: Read page caches shrink from an 8 MiB to a 2 MiB target per connection by default, reducing retained reader memory. Reads on very large stores may do more disk I/O.

replay.detail: No claim replay or projection rebuilding changes.

schema.detail: No database schema, schema digest, claim shape or store format changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordinated fleet transition changes. Checkpoint proof copies retain their separate 8 MiB cache target.

compatibility.detail: No client, protocol or harness contract changes. The existing SMALLCLAIMS_READ_CACHE_KIB override remains supported.

downtime.detail: No deploy hold or automatic restart is required. Running daemons keep their cache target until restarted; the smaller default takes effect in a new process without an override.

manual.detail: To restore the previous 8 MiB reader target, set SMALLCLAIMS_READ_CACHE_KIB=8192 in the daemon's environment and restart it. Retention stays at up to 128 idle readers by default, and page-cache targets are not total RSS limits.

recovery.detail: The override works with prior binaries. Rolling back restores the previous default without a data migration.
